title: Honour drift-recovery baseline in dev release capture

reproduction.incident_description: Failed deployment run 34926312378 on 2026-09-15 replaced containers with dc15751a9 but skipped admit/switch, leaving the live VM BFF serving dc15751a9 while the accepted frontend pair deployment.json ledger retained ae41705b4 as previous_backend_sha. On run 35120908258, step rollback_baseline detected the discrepancy and classified baseline_source as standby_frontend_pair_manifest+live_bff_drift_recovery, but dev_release_artifact_driver.py rigidly enforced source_commit_sha == previous_backend_sha, failing with exit 75.

root_cause.artifacts_image_revisions: dev_release_artifacts.py:capture_images(), validate_images(), and restore_images() enforced service image revisions to strictly equal source_sha without allowing observed live drift revisions.
root_cause.workflow_outputs_missing: .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml step rollback_baseline did not write baseline_source or observed_live_bff_sha to $GITHUB_OUTPUT for artifact_baseline or deploy.

fix_description.dev_release_artifacts_py: Added allowed_revisions parameter to capture_images, validate_images, and restore_images, accepting OCI revisions that match allowed_revisions in addition to source_sha.
fix_description.dev_release_artifact_driver_py: Added _drift_recovery_source(args) helper validating +live_bff_drift_recovery and 40-hex lowercase SHA; plumbed validation into _identity(); updated _public() to accept drift_sha in allowed_sources; updated RestoreCAS._public_source() to permit drift_sha; passed allowed_revisions into capture, seal-candidate, verify, and restore; added --baseline-source and --observed-live-bff-sha CLI arguments with env var fallback.
fix_description.nonprod_deploy_yml: Exported baseline_source and observed_live_bff_sha from step rollback_baseline to GITHUB_OUTPUT; injected PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_BASELINE_SOURCE and PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_OBSERVED_LIVE_BFF_SHA into step artifact_baseline and step deploy.
fix_description.test_coverage: Added unit and regression tests in test_dev_release_artifacts.py (test_capture_and_validate_images_accept_drift_recovery_allowed_revisions) and test_dev_release_artifact_driver.py (reproduction test, drift recovery capture/seal/verify/restore test, and fail-closed tests covering non-JSON/500 BFF version, 3rd party SHA, permissive/stub auth, viewer readback denial, tampered FE manifest, invalid drift SHA format, and missing drift recovery classification).

invariants_enforced.eight_field_identity: The 8-field identity contract (candidate_id, run_id, attempt, controller_sha, candidate_backend_sha, candidate_frontend_sha, previous_backend_sha, previous_frontend_sha) is unchanged; rollback authority remains previous_backend_sha.
invariants_enforced.manifest_structure: Baseline manifest schema pantheon.dev-release-artifact-baseline.v1 and all 12 top-level keys remain strictly preserved.
invariants_enforced.fail_closed_security: Any unadmitted SHA, stubbed auth, non-strict posture, tampered frontend manifest, or unclassified drift strictly fails closed with ArtifactError.
invariants_enforced.isolation: Pure source and isolated test scope only; no hosted deployments, redeploys, or capital changes performed.
